result.title: When Is Product Decoding of ECOC MAP-Consistent? Pair Structure and the n-vs-Rest Codes
result.comment: 17 pages, 4 figures. Lean 4 formalization of all theorems in the ancillary files
result.summary: Error-Correcting Output Codes (ECOC) combine binary classifiers by the sum decoder, which totals probabilities, or the product decoder, which totals log-likelihoods. In the noiseless setting, where the binary classifiers output the true posteriors, we ask on which code matrices each decoder always agrees with the Bayes-optimal (MAP) class. For the sum decoder the answer is known: the code must be equidistant (James and Hastie, 1998). We answer the question for the product decoder. Two classes are compared through the votes of the columns on which they differ: the sum decoder decides by their sample mean, the product decoder by an M-estimator with influence function artanh, and each vote is the MAP margin plus a bias determined by the other classes alone. Our main theorem states that the product decoder is MAP-consistent if and only if, for every class pair, the columns on which the two classes differ are matched with the columns obtained by swapping the two classes (or their complements), and equivalently if and only if the code is a union of n-vs-Rest codes. Efficient equidistant codes are therefore excluded: Hadamard codes ($M\ge 8$), which meet the Plotkin bound with $M-1$ columns, have no such pairs, and for the Sylvester type the reversal margin can be at least a constant 0.0182 independent of $M$. All theorems are machine-checked in Lean 4. On six real datasets with estimated probabilities, the product decoder is slightly more accurate when each column is calibrated, and the sum decoder is better when the calibration error differs across columns; in either case the decoders disagree only near ties.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 ECOC 多分类中 product decoder（对数似然求和）在何种码矩阵上总与 Bayes 最优类一致，给出充要条件——每对类别的差异列须成对匹配，等价于码为 n-vs-Rest 码的并；据此排除 Hadamard 等距码，并在六个真实数据集上比较 product 与 sum 解码的校准敏感性，全部定理经 Lean 4 形式化验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其关于多路二值证据的乘积式聚合（log-likelihood 求和）、逐列校准误差如何影响解码选择以及「仅在对齐处分歧」的分析，可能为 LVR 中多个 latent 假设或视觉证据通道的聚合与校准提供参照，是否可迁移到 latent 状态整合尚待核查。
